## Source: amazon-inspector (86aff08f0bbfb1714c6cc7f7ad247593b3ecd2bcee1cb2c3139f250ee305fc1b)
paystation-embed-app@1.0.0 is a non-functional package whose sole behavior is an install-time phone-home. package.json declares `postinstall: node index.js`, and index.js reads `os.hostname()` and `process.cwd()` and issues an HTTP POST to the hardcoded anonymous collector https://webhook.site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5 with a generated test ID and status field. The package.json description is `security testiong only`, the author field is empty, and the declared keywords (svg, bucket, assets, cloud) are unrelated to the code. The package provides no library or CLI functionality; installing it fingerprints the host to an author-controlled anonymous endpoint on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
